Greetings, Partygoers!!

The day has finally come! Taboo University is officially out on Steam, and now you have the chance to be one of the first to dive into this thrilling world! 🎉

So, set everything aside and start uncovering the mysteries and secrets! But remember—temptation is everywhere, and even the best detectives can stray off the path. Who can resist with so many stunning students around?

 Choose Your Faction.

 Become part of a criminal syndicate and save your crew.
 Experience the adrenaline rush of underground fights and shady deals.
 Compete in college volleyball tournaments.
 And most importantly, dive into the wild world of parties and hot dates with gorgeous college students and stunning MILFs!

Pick your path, make bold choices, and experience all the joys of college life!

notes.title: Fetish Locator Season 3 new release!
notes.notes:
More enlightening content awaits you 

We are approaching the end of our story, but we are not quite there yet! Day-20 is focusing on finishing 
up some storylines and on the study life of our MC! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38274604/e936eb3f3dae1046bc66549327314e8ee945d797.png
We worked hard on this one! ;)

Did you make the right choices to prepare for exams? Would other characters help you? Do you even need to pass exams? Play day-20 and figure it out! 

Visit our Patreon and gain access to Week 3 and Day 20 right now! Week 3 won't be available on Steam for a while, so hurry up and go try it out!

We are also looking forward to starting to make endings! You will get full mini-stories where the whole focus is on one storyline and one or a set of characters. There is still a lot of work before the FL Week-3 will be finished! But for now, get to Day-20 and play it!

notes.title: v1.0.42 Bugfix update
notes.notes:
Today a small update was added that fixes some issues that were reported to us by you.
The only major fix was for the Spanish version of the game that was crushing on Day-3.
Thanks, everyone for reporting issues! Stay healthy and Fetish on!

notes.title: Week One update to prepare for Week-2
notes.notes:
Preparation for Week Two
Week Two is coming soon! We are in the last stages of making the game. There are some things still left to do, like passing Steam review and finishing all the translations. That is why it is hard to give you all the exact date, but we really hope that it will happen this month!
Meanwhile, there is some quality update for Week One adding a new save system, that will help you to transfer your progress from Week One to Week Two. Basically it won't ask you to save the game yourself, but will save it for you at the end of the story.

Portuguese added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38274604/559e96d36617a4ca0f6f7850f15bef92d6e30a54.jpg
And we are happy to support the new language! Week Two will also be translated to Portuguese!

notes.title: Halloween Update for Fetish Locator!
notes.notes:
Hello, my fellow Fetish lovers!
While we are working full speed on the Week-2 and by now we have already finished Day-8 and Day-9, we are still going to update the Week-1 with some good quality changes!
Spanish Language!
First of all thanks to our community the game is now playable in Spanish! Hurray!!
https://i.postimg.cc/kgxx9DZ4/spanish.png
Quality updates
We added lots of animations to replace old animations and re-rendered some scenes completely to update it to the quality that we want!
https://i.postimg.cc/W1Pk9T3P/quality.png
Halloween exclusive bonus items
If you log into the game during the Halloween event you can participate in a small Pumpkin Hunt! Find 3 pumpkins to unlock several bonus-renders!!
https://i.postimg.cc/MG9dBdSN/halloween.png
Game Credits
We also added proper game credits at the end of Week-1! I recommend you check it out!
https://i.postimg.cc/W3K8Wzt7/credits.png

I hope you enjoy the game and we will have more things for you in the future!
